summary: This directory manages JSON Web Token operations, providing the necessary infrastructure to sign, generate, and validate authentication tokens using secure key-based cryptographic standards for user verification.
responsibilities: Configuring JWT signing and verification parameters
Generating signed tokens for user authentication
Validating incoming token authenticity against public keys
relationships: Token generation utilizes signing configurations to create secure authentication credentials.
Verification processes use public keys to ensure the integrity and authenticity of received tokens.
designDecisions: Configuration-based approach for managing signing and verification options
